entries.name: CAN bus transceiver
entries.summary: CAN (Controller Area Network) lets electronic devices exchange messages. A transceiver is the part that sends and receives the network's electrical signals.

entries.name: CAN FD transceiver
entries.summary: CAN FD means CAN with Flexible Data Rate. Its transceiver sends and receives the electrical signals used by that compatible network.

entries.name: LIN bus transceiver
entries.summary: LIN means Local Interconnect Network, a communication system for connected electronic devices. Its transceiver handles the network's electrical signals.

entries.name: RS-485 transceiver
entries.summary: An RS-485 transceiver sends and receives differential serial signals on its specified bus arrangement.

entries.name: RS-422 interface
entries.summary: An RS-422 interface uses differential signalling for its selected serial connection.

entries.name: RS-232 transceiver
entries.summary: An RS-232 transceiver converts between logic-level serial signals and the selected RS-232 electrical interface.

entries.name: Ethernet physical-layer transceiver
entries.summary: An Ethernet PHY handles the electrical signalling of the selected Ethernet physical link.

entries.name: Single-pair Ethernet interface
entries.summary: A single-pair Ethernet interface uses its specified physical-layer arrangement over one conductor pair.

entries.name: PoE powered-device interface
entries.summary: A PoE powered-device interface manages the receiving end of power delivered over a compatible Ethernet link.

entries.name: PoE power-sourcing interface
entries.summary: A PoE power-sourcing interface manages the supply end of a compatible powered Ethernet connection.

entries.name: I2C bus buffer
entries.summary: An I2C bus buffer separates or supports selected parts of an I2C connection.

entries.name: I2C voltage-level translator
entries.summary: An I2C level translator adapts the specified logic-voltage levels between compatible bus sections.

entries.name: SPI interface buffer
entries.summary: An SPI buffer supports the selected digital signal paths between an SPI controller and its peripheral interface.

entries.name: LVDS line driver
entries.summary: An LVDS driver converts a logic signal into the selected low-voltage differential output.

entries.name: LVDS line receiver
entries.summary: An LVDS receiver converts a compatible differential input into its specified logic output.

entries.name: Isolated CAN transceiver
entries.summary: An isolated CAN interface combines a CAN signal path with its specified electrical isolation barrier.

entries.name: Isolated RS-485 transceiver
entries.summary: An isolated RS-485 interface transfers compatible serial communication across a specified isolation barrier.

entries.name: Isolated I2C interface
entries.summary: An isolated I2C interface transfers the required bus behaviour across an electrical isolation barrier.
